_about: Every secret Clipping Studio uses, in one file, to back up or move to another computer. The real one is secrets/secrets.json (git ignores the secrets/ folder): run `python scripts/collect-secrets.py` to make it from this computer. The app does not read this file; each value lives where its 'goes_to' says. Keep the real file off GitHub and out of chats.

public_url.what: The public https address Instagram reaches the app on (your ngrok address). Only needed for Instagram.

ngrok_authtoken.what: Signs ngrok in to your ngrok account (dashboard.ngrok.com, Your Authtoken).

google_app.goes_to: data/apps.json as {"google": {"id": ..., "secret": ...}}, or Settings, Connected apps, YouTube, Set up
google_app.what: The Google Cloud OAuth client that YouTube uploads go through.

accounts.goes_to: data/users/u_local/accounts/accounts.json, as a list of the objects below
accounts.what: Connected posting accounts. YouTube keeps a refresh_token (lasts until revoked). An Instagram account added with a Meta dashboard token has api: facebook; that token lasts about 60 days and is not renewed by the app.

brain_token.what: The password the Claude Code brain uses on the app's /api/brain doors. Any long random text works; the app makes one if missing.

link_key_hex.goes_to: data/link.key, as the raw bytes of this hex
link_key_hex.what: Signs the one-hour clip links Instagram downloads. The app makes a new one if missing; a new one only breaks links already handed out.

not_in_this_file: Content Rewards login: cookies in data/cr-profile/ (copy the folder, or press Log in on the Campaigns page again)
Claude Code login: kept by Claude Code itself (/login in the brain window)
GitHub login: kept by Git Credential Manager
